# Open Model Family Tree

> The ancestry of every model on the Hugging Face Hub, rebuilt nightly from declared base_model metadata. Generated 2026-11-25 from the 2026-11-25 Hub dump.

- 3,266,893 models tracked, 946,365 declare a base model, 979,852 parent links, 94,198 models have descendants.
- Counts are unique descendants (finetunes, adapters, quantizations, merges), each counted once.
